# Canvas for AI

> These tools let agents show work in a canvas for the user.

- [Tool data](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/janpmz/canvas-for-ai/main/catalog.json): tasks, access, example_prompt, example_url.
- [UI Design Editor](https://uidesigneditor.com/): editable designs.
- [PDF TO MP3 Canvas](https://pdftomp3.com/canvas/): Send text through its public API. You do not need an account or plugin. [Example](https://pdftomp3.com/canvas/?example=1).
- [In-App Editor](https://github.com/janpmz/in-app-editor): Edit a copy of a website in the browser. Copy a prompt to apply the edits to its files. [Setup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/janpmz/in-app-editor/main/instructions.md).
